_about: US Renal - Adult (us-renal-adult) transcription, W1, 2026-10-15. Proposed additions to vocabulary/indicators.json. NOT CLINICALLY REVIEWED. Every entry traces to a printed atom on pp.52-55 of National ID 15372 v2.0 (see transcription-notes.md section 1). Group placement note: the vocabulary has no history/comorbidity/medication group, so patient-background facts (pregnancy, smoking, allergy, medication, comorbidity, BMI, catheter) are proposed under `patient`; the vocabulary owner may prefer a new group before any of these linkIds is published (REVIEW Q17).

add.notes: US Renal p52 'if pregnant or female younger than 35 years old'; p54 'Suspected renal colic in a non-pregnant person'. CT KUB p25/p26 and US DVT p35 also print pregnancy conditions (not read for this entry).
US Renal p52 'current or ex-smoker'; p53 'non-smoker' and 'any smoking status (current or ex-smoker, or non-smoker)' - the three-way partition is printed, so a choice rather than a boolean.

add.text: History of allergy to IV contrast
add.notes: CT IVU p23 guidance prints 'known allergy to iodinated contrast' (guidance, not a criterion).
US Renal p52 'eGFR less than 45 with diabetes'. Diabetes is printed at other sites (e.g. p50 'Diabetes mellitus' as a risk factor) - not read for this entry.

add.text: New diagnosis of chronic kidney disease (CKD)

add.notes: Value justified: 'provided BMI is less than 30' (p54). No unit printed; kg/m2 by convention.

add.text: Taking prophylactic antibiotics for urinary tract infection
add.notes: p53 'more than 2 in six months despite prophylactic antibiotics'.

The criteria distinguish macroscopic from microscopic haematuria, which symptom.haematuria (generic, composed by RF-24) cannot express. Not a near-duplicate: a sub-concept. CT IVU/CT Renal p23 prints 'Macroscopic haematuria' (not read for this entry).
See symptom.haematuriaMacroscopic. CT IVU/CT Renal p23 prints 'microscopic haematuria' (not read for this entry).

Composed with redflag.renalColicAcuteEpisode (the renal colic presentation itself); this indicator carries only 'first presentation'. CT KUB p25 prints 'First presentation of suspected renal colic' - the same concept.
'e.g. new onset incontinence with palpable enlarged bladder' is illustrative (KI-05) and is not composed into this indicator.

add.text: Number of confirmed urinary tract infections
add.notes: p53 men: 'recurrent UTI (i.e. 2 or more confirmed UTI)' - no time window is printed (REVIEW Q9).

add.text: Number of urinary tract infections in the last year
add.notes: p53 women: 'more than 3 UTIs in a year'.

add.text: Number of urinary tract infections in the last six months
add.notes: p53 women: 'more than 2 in six months despite prophylactic antibiotics'.

p54 not-funded 'Recurrent UTIs in women, except as documented above'. The not-funded row does not define 'recurrent', so this is the referral's own statement; the P3 rows use the counts instead (REVIEW Q10).
p54 'Macroscopic haematuria in patients who do not have a UTI'. CT IVU p23 prints 'UTI excluded' (not read for this entry).

add.text: Recurrent loin pain suggesting renal tract obstruction other than renal stone
add.notes: Rests on the referrer's clinical judgement ('suggesting'); candidate for the AD-17 attestation category (REVIEW Q16). Not added to attestationIndicators here.
Not the same as the '+/- lower UTI symptoms' modifier in the p52 pyelonephritis row (RF-12), which is not encoded.
p54 not-funded 'who are not systemically unwell' - read with `not`; unknown does not fire the not-funded row.

add.text: Decrease in eGFR within the previous 12 months
add.notes: Value justified: 'eGFR decreased by 15 or more within the previous 12 months' (p52). A decrease computed by the model from two eGFR results is a conversion and is 'inferred' (contract rule 3) - REVIEW Q12.
Not redflag.impairedRenalFunction (paediatric RF-24, no 'new or deteriorating' qualifier).
Boolean flag (KI-06); no numeric threshold is printed, so no .value sibling.
Not redflag.heavyProteinuria (paediatric RF-24).

add.text: Urine culture shows persistent bacteriuria with same organism following treatment with appropriate antibiotic
add.notes: The 'persistent UTI (i.e. ...)' definition for both men and women (p53); 'i.e.' defines the condition.

add.text: Patient has previously had a renal ultrasound
add.notes: p54 'Repeat renal ultrasound for diabetic patients ...'. Window `ever` per the priorImaging convention; not imaging.usrenal.moreThan12mAgo (paediatric p85, a different window).

add.text: Incidental finding on ultrasound of a solid lesion with typical ultrasound appearances of an angiomyolipoma
Diameter of the incidental solid lesion found on ultrasound, in cm
add.notes: Value justified: 'more than 1 cm diameter' (alternative management) and 'less 1 cm diameter' (not funded), p54. CT IVU p23 prints 'a solid lesion more than1cm in diameter' (not read for this entry).

add.text: Further imaging is indicated by the radiology report
add.notes: p55 'unless indicated by the radiology report'. CT IVU p23 prints 'recommended by ... Radiology report' (not read for this entry).

add.text: Follow up, according to the Renal Colic and Urinary Tract Stones HealthPathway
add.notes: CT KUB p25 S2 prints 'Follow up, as recommended by the local Renal Colic and Urinary Tract Stones HealthPathway' - the same concept.

Printed as 'if calculus not visible on KUB X-ray' (p54); stored positively and read with `not` (KI-01, one indicator for both polarities). CT KUB p25 prints 'if a calculus is not visible on KUB X-ray'.
A request purpose (not-routinely-funded marker), not the presence of hypertension: a patient with uncomplicated hypertension referred for another reason must not answer true.

add.text: Follow-up imaging of simple renal cysts (Bosniak I and II)
add.notes: A request purpose (not-routinely-funded marker).

add.text: Screening scan for Autosomal Dominant Polycystic Kidney Disease (ADPKD)
add.notes: A request purpose (not-routinely-funded marker).

add.text: Serial ultrasounds of known polycystic kidneys
add.notes: A request purpose (not-routinely-funded marker). The printed 'unless' clauses are composed in the site library from imaging.furtherImagingRecommendedByReport and the site's own criteria.
